svg.text: Quantum computing, end to end — a concept map in concert-hall terms
Each box gives the technical name, then the same idea as a string, a player, a score, or a recording in one concert hall. Theory sits in bands 1–3, the hardware in 4–6, the software in 7–8,
and band 9 is the honest scoreboard. Read top to bottom and follow the arrows to see what depends on what. State of play as of September 2026.
1 · THE STRINGS · theory: what a qubit is, and why it is strange · 1900s–1980s
2 · THE SCORE · theory: gates and circuits, the programming model · 1985–2017
3 · THE COMPOSITIONS · theory: algorithms, and what they are actually good for · 1992–2014
4 · THE INSTRUMENTS · hardware: how a qubit is physically built · 1999–2026
5 · THE CONCERT HALL · hardware: the physical stack around the qubits · 2010s–2026
6 · KEEPING IN TUNE · hardware meets software: noise, mitigation, error correction · 1995–2026
7 · THE SOFTWARE STACK · software: from Python down to pulses · 2016–2026
8 · LOCKS AND KEYS · software: cryptography and the real-world stakes · 1984–2035
9 · WHERE IT ACTUALLY STANDS · the scoreboard, as of September 2026
